protocol.scope: all 35,126 EyePACS manifest images; every same-side pair compared once
protocol.candidate_generator: 256-bit signed DCT of a cropped retinal canvas; Hamming distance <= configured maximum
protocol.identity_gate: separate bilateral SIFT rule: >=50 same-side inliers and <=10 laterality-swapped inliers
protocol.guardrail: candidate count is detector scope, not all-person identity prevalence

blank_frame_policy: retained with an explicit fixed DCT signature; no blank image may pass the subsequent SIFT identity gate
